translation.name: Kazuwamgbani ka savu n Tsikimba n aɓon a ɗa a ɗanga̱sai a kazuwamgbani ka cau

content: Kazuwamgbani ka utuwa̱ u Kulu Keri
Uzapige Tiyofilu: An n koronku vu caupa vi, n korongu ta̱ gba̱ ili iꞌya Yesu yansai kpam u wenishikei, ili iꞌya i bidyai aꞌayin a ɗa u gita̱i manyan ma ne

hal ubana kain ka a canga yi ubana a zuba. An u ꞌya̱nga̱i a ukpa̱, u wenishike ta̱ kaci ka ne a asu u asuki a ne a ɗa u ɗanga̱sai hal aꞌayin amangare. U yansa ta̱ ili ushani iꞌya i wenikei an wa̱ri n uma mayun. An aꞌayin a ɗa a ka canga yi ubana a zuba a yain evu, u dansa ta̱ n ele ukuna u tsugono tsu Kashila̱ u tonusuko le kpam ili iꞌya a ka yan. Gba̱ ili i na yi u yansa ta̱ iꞌya a asuvu a ucira u Kulu Keri.
Kain ka te an wa̱ri kaɓolo n ele a asu u ulya ilikulya, u tonuko le, “Kotsu i laza pini a Urishelima wa hal she Tata u sukunku ɗa̱ kune ku u zuwamgbanai vi. Ma̱ri n tonuko ɗa̱ ɗe ukuna u na vi caupa.
Yahaya lyuɓugusu ta̱ ama n mini, shegai ubana a kapala kenu, a ka lyuɓugu ɗa̱ ta̱ n Kulu Keri.”
A cangai Yesu ubana a zuba
Kain ka te, an asuki yi a ɓolomgbonoi a asu u te kaɓolo n Yesu, a wece yi, “Asheku, aꞌayin a ɗa va gonuko aza a Isaraꞌila tsugono tsu le a ɗa na vi?”
U tonuko le, “Tata ɗa koshi wa̱ri n ucira u ɗa wa reve aꞌayin a ɗa u foɓusoi vi, eɗa̱ ya reve wa.

Shegai ya wusha ta̱ ucira aꞌayin a ɗa Kulu Keri ku cipa̱i asuvu a ɗe. Ya woko ta̱ aza ɗa ya shamkpa mu a Urishelima, n gba̱ a asuvu a Yahuda. I tonuko kpam aza a Samariya hal ubana a asuvu a likimba gba̱.”
An u kotsoi kadyanshi ka na ki, ele n a wundi yi, aku a canga yi a mere ma le ubana a zuba. Pini nala, kalishi ka kimba̱ yi, a doku a wene yi kpam wa.
Aꞌayin a ɗa aꞌa̱ri pini a uwundya zuba vi, kute‑kute ama a re uꞌuki n aminya a eri a shamgbai evu n ele.
A tonuko le, “Aza a Galili, ndya i zuwai iꞌa̱ri kushani ya wundya zuba? Yesu ɗa i wenei a cangai ubana a zuba na vi, nala kpam wa gono.”
A ɗanga̱sai kasuki ka savu
Aku asuki yi a lazai pini a Masasa ma Zayitum mi a gonoi a Urishelima, kpam nte masasa mi ma̱ri pini evu n Urishelima vi; wata, kagbidi ka mel u te.

An a rawai a ilyuci yi, aku a yuwa̱i a kunukuzuba a asu u ɗa a tsu cipa̱. Ama ɗa aꞌa̱ri pini vi alya; Bituru, n Yahaya, n Yakubu. Andurawu, n Filibu, n Toma aꞌa̱ ta̱ dem pini. Aza ɗa aꞌa̱ri pini a ɓolomgbono ta̱ dem n Batalamawu, n Matiyu, n Yakubu maku ma Halfa, n Simo uza ɗa a ka isa̱ Ziloti, n Yahuza maku ma Yakubu.
A tsu ɓolomgbono ta̱ kpam a na̱ka̱i kaci ka le adama a kavasu n katakasuvu ka te. Aka roku a ɗa dem pini hal n Meri mma u Yesu n aꞌangu a Yesu yi.
Aꞌayin a nala yi, kakuma̱ ka ama ka ka rawai ama amangatawun n kamanga (120) aza ɗa a pityanangi ka ka ɓolomgbonoi. Pini nala, Bituru shamgbai a mere ma le u danai,
“Ama a va̱, u ka̱na̱ ta̱ a shaɗangu udani u Kashila̱ u ɗa Kulu Keri ku danai caupa a una̱ u Dawuda a kaci ka Yahuza, uza ɗa u tonoi n aza ɗa a ka̱na̱i Yesu.
Kpaci caupa uza u te u ɗa a asuvu a tsunu, kpam a na̱ka̱ yi ta̱ kapashi ka manyan ka ne a asuvu a manyan ma na mi.”
(U tsila ta̱ uyamba n ikebe iꞌya u tsa̱ra̱i a asu u manyan ma cingi mi. Pini nala, u rukpa̱i kaci uvari, aku katsuma̱ ka ne ka ta̱sa̱i, ucanga u katsuma̱ vi u tsa̱la̱i a iyamba.
Gba̱ aza ɗa aꞌa̱ri a Urishelima a pana ta̱ ukuna u na vi, aku a nekei asu vi kala, Akaladama n kaletsu ka le; wata, “Uyamba u Mpasa.”)
Bituru lyai kapala n kadyanshi, “Kpaci wa̱ ta̱ ukorongi a asuvu a Tagara̱da u Ishipa,†

content.text: ‘A̱sa̱ka̱ kuwa ku ne ku woko uvarangi,
kpam kotsu uza u dusuku pini wa.’

content: “Kpam a dana ta̱,

content.text: ‘Kapashi ka manyan ka ne ki uza roku u bidya ka.’

content: “Adama a nala u ka̱na̱ ta̱ a ɗanga̱sa uza roku a asuvu a ama a na yi, uza ɗa wa̱ri kaɓolo n a̱tsu caupa aꞌayin a ɗa Yesu Asheku wa̱ri n a̱tsu.

U ka̱na̱ ta̱ vuma vi u woko uza ɗa u rongoi n a̱tsu tun aꞌayin a ɗa Yahaya lyuɓugi Yesu hal ubana aꞌayin a ɗa a canga yi ubana a zuba. U ka̱na̱ ta̱ vuma vi u ɓolomgbono kaci n a̱tsu, u woko uza ɗa wa tonuko ama ukuna u uꞌya̱nga̱ u ne a ukpa̱.”
Pini nala, a wutukpa̱i ama a re, Isuhu Bara̱saba uza ɗa a ka isa̱ Yusutu, n Mataya.
Asuki yi a yain kavasu a danai, “Asheku, ya dem vu reve ta̱ katakasuvu ka ne. Wenike tsu uza ɗa vu ɗanga̱sai a asuvu a ama a re a na yi,
u woko kasuki. U bidya manyan ma Yahuza kasuki u a̱sa̱ka̱i kpaci u bana ɗe asu u ɗa u yain dere n eyi.”
A varangi uruta, aku u rukpa̱i a kaci ka Mataya, pini nala, a zuwa yi u woko kasuki kaɓolo n kupa n u te vi.

footnotes.text: Kaletsu ka aza a Yahuda ka da, mɓa̱ri mi “Nwalu n kain ka Ashibi n ɗa koshi.” Mele ma aza a Yahuda ma wushuku uza u yain nwalu n ɗa n wurai kilomita u te, ko kpam kagbidi ka mel u te n kain ka Ashibi wa. N ɗa ma wura la vi nwalu n minti kupa ko kpam udeshe azu a tatsu wa.
